name: Takumi Anno
source:
A former wrestler in his freshman and sophomore year, but now just enjoys kicking back and enjoying the easy life. Never takes anything too seriously. Big hugger. His smile seems to be glued on at all times. Lover of all things comfortable and his girlfriend, Hina.

[From [url=https://www.tsofgame.com/characters]official website[/url]]
